gh_fe8b4626130f1dbf285f10cf.title: [Híbrido] Angular Front-End Developer Sênior na Sylision
gh_fe8b4626130f1dbf285f10cf.description:
## Nossa empresa

A [Sylision](https://sylision.com) é uma plataforma de recrutamento de tecnologia que atua no Brasil e em Portugal. Recrutamos para empresas parceiras e usamos inteligência artificial para cruzar o seu currículo com todas as vagas compatíveis do nosso banco próprio. Você se candidata uma única vez.

## Descrição da vaga

Vaga de Front-End Developer (Angular) nível Sênior para atuar em projetos de empresas parceiras da Sylision.

Faixa salarial: R$ 12.000 a R$ 22.000/mês, conforme experiência.

## Local

Híbrido ou remoto, a combinar com a empresa contratante.

## Requisitos

**Obrigatórios:**
- Experiência profissional com Angular (5 anos ou mais)
- Angular 15+ e TypeScript
- RxJS
- Consumo de APIs REST
- Karma ou Jest

**Diferenciais:**
- NgRx
- Micro-frontends
- Design system

## Benefícios

- Faixa salarial de R$ 12.000 a 22.000/mês, publicada aqui e não negociada por último
- Vale-refeição ou vale-alimentação
- Ajuda de custo / auxílio home office para quem atua remoto
- Auxílio mobilidade ou vale-transporte para os dias presenciais
- Plano de saúde e odontológico
- Day off de aniversário e apoio a cursos e certificações
- O pacote final é o da empresa contratante e é confirmado antes de qualquer entrevista

## Contratação

CLT ou PJ, conforme sua preferência e acordo com a empresa contratante.

## Como se candidatar

Candidate-se pela página da vaga: https://www.sylision.com/vagas/desenvolvedor-angular-senior

Basta enviar o currículo uma vez. A IA da Sylision considera o seu perfil para esta e para todas as vagas compatíveis, inclusive as que abrirem depois.

## Tempo médio de feedbacks

A IA da Sylision analisa o CV em minutos; quando há compatibilidade, um headhunter entra em contato em até 7 dias.
E-mail para contato em caso de não haver resposta: giovani@sylision.com

## Labels

#### Alocação
- Híbrido

#### Regime
- CLT
- PJ

#### Nível
- Sênior

gh_feb466ba4cbe4c6806ea058b.title: [徵才][台北] [AI 新創公司] Senior Backend and Data Engineer | Deeli AI | GO / Python
gh_feb466ba4cbe4c6806ea058b.description:
## About the Role

We’re looking for a full-time Senior Backend & Data Engineer to join us in scaling and strengthening our data and infrastructure stack. You’ll work closely with our dev and AI/data teams to design APIs, pipelines, and backend systems that support deep tech applications.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. You’ll be trusted to contribute actively to architectural decisions, improve system robustness, and collaborate cross-functionally to ship production-ready features. If you enjoy working across systems and shaping product direction in a fast-moving environment, we’d love to meet you.

## Office Location
臺北市松山區捷運中山國中站

## Your Responsibilities

- Collaborate with dev, AI and product teams to design and implement scalable backend services in Golang and Python
- Build and optimize ETL/data pipelines that support data exploration, enrichment, and delivery workflows
- Help maintain and improve our PostgreSQL, Elastic Stack, and vector database infrastructure
- Support DevOps efforts including CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and cloud infrastructure (GCP or equivalent)
- Improve system performance and reliability through thoughtful observability, alerting, and load testing
- Contribute to internal best practices and co-shape engineering standards as the team grows
- If interested, optionally support other areas such as web scraping, NLP, or Agentic AI integration

## Must-Have Qualifications
- 5+ years of experience in product development, with solid backend and infrastructure skills
- Proficient in Golang (Gin, GORM) and Python (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy)
- Experienced in designing robust APIs with a product-minded perspective and focus on practical trade-offs
- Skilled in working with relational, search, and vector databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, pgvector)
- Proficient with Docker and containerized development workflows
- Capable of building ETL/data pipelines, and familiar with concepts of data lakes and data warehouses
- Experienced in setting up CI/CD pipelines and managing cloud infrastructure (GCP or others)
- Comfortable with Git version control and collaborative workflows
- Fluent in Mandarin
- Fluent in English, both spoken and written, able to communicate effectively in global teams
- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset

## Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with performance optimization on large-scale datasets and distributed systems
- Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks (React.js, Vue.js) and frontend-backend integration
- Experience working with vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant), NLP pipelines, and Agentic AI systems
- Comfortable with Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and large-scale web crawling infrastructure

## Compensation

Total compensation—including base salary and equity—is typically in the range of 2M–2.5M TWD annually.
We believe in rewarding talent not just fairly—but boldly. You’ll be compensated like a key contributor, not a cog in the machine.

## About Deeli AI

In an era of data explosion and AI advancements, innovation decisions still rely on guesswork. Global enterprises invest billions in innovation exploration annually, yet miss critical opportunities due to fragmented signals and gut instinct. This isn't just an efficiency problem—it's a massive waste of innovation potential.

After two decades in innovation, we’ve seen this challenge firsthand. There’s never been a reliable system for identifying high-potential and viable leading-edge technologies early and making confident decisions.
That’s why we built Deeli AI — To empower every innovation-driven company to innovate boldly and confidently—with the right data, at the right time.

Backed by the Berkeley SkyDeck Fund and part of Batch 18, Deeli AI is creating the world’s first AI-native innovation intelligence platform. We aggregate global signals—academic research, patents, grants, and hidden startups—to surface emerging technologies before the market reacts. Founded by a second-time entrepreneur and built by a world-class team with experience at MediaTek, AWS, and Deloitte, we've recently launched our beta and secured PoCs with two of the world's top semiconductor companies-each potentially valued in the hundreds of thousands (USD).

Now is the perfect moment to join us—at a critical inflection point where your contribution can shape the company and the future of innovation itself.

Email Abel [abel.chen@deeli.ai](mailto:abel.chen@deeli.ai) to apply or learn more.

gh_fe163f248daddc4797824c43.description:
[台北內湖][100K以上面議]  Java Developer  (Spring Boot)

[公司介紹]
博彥科技（深交所上市公司：002649）是亞洲領先的全方位IT諮詢服務及行業解決方案提供商，在全球三大洲的六個國家設有超過30個分支機構和交付中心，具備全球範圍的交付能力和靈活多樣的交付方式。博彥專注於領先的全方位IT服務及行業解決方案，業務範圍涵蓋諮詢、產品研發、信息技術服務、系統集成、業務流程外包等服務，專注於高科技、互聯網、金融、電信、消費電子、製造、製藥、醫療、汽車、媒體、能源、科研教育和政府等領域，與眾多全球500強企業和行業新銳公司成功合作，積累了豐富的經驗。博彥的行業領軍地位得到了業內權威研究機構的認可，先後被評為IDC中國IT外包十強、IAOP全球外包100強、Global Service全球100強、加拿大CDN“解決方案供應商100強”、中國十大外包領軍企業及中國最佳雇主企業。

[工作內容]
• 2-3 年以上使用 J2EE 開發 Web 應用程序的經驗
•2- 3 年以上 Spring Boot 經驗
• 良好的微服務知識
• 有使用Git、Maven、JFrog、UDeploy 等工具的經驗。
• 使用微服務開發企業級 Web 應用程序和 RESTful API 的專業知識，具有可證明的生產規模經驗
• 必須具備行業標準協議相關 API 安全（包括 OAuth）的工作經驗
• 在 Unix 和 Windows 環境中使用 JSON、Web 服務、XML、XSLT、PL/SQL 展示強大的設計和編程技能
• 強大的 Linux/UNIX 環境工作背景
• 強大的 Shell 腳本編寫經驗
• 使用 Oracle、DB2 或 Mongo DB 數據庫的知識
• 熱衷於了解科技界的最新動態，並願意討論並將其發揮作用
• 強大的敏捷/Scrum 開發經驗
• 在分佈式項目團隊中具有很強的協作和溝通能力
• 出色的書面和口頭溝通技巧

Requirements
•	2-3+ years of experience developing web applications using J2EE
•	2-3+ years of experience in Spring Boot
•	Good knowledge of Micro Services
•	Experience working with tools like Git, Maven, JFrog, UDeploy.
•	Expertise developing enterprise-level web applications and RESTful APIs using MicroServices, with demonstrable production-scale experience
•	Working experience in Industry Standard protocols related API Security including OAuth is a must
•	Demonstrate strong design and programming skills using JSON, Web Services, XML, XSLT, PL/SQL in Unix and Windows environments
•	Strong background working with Linux/UNIX environments
•	Strong Shell scripting experience
•	Working knowledge with Oracle, DB2 or Mongo DB databases
•	Passion to stay on top of the latest happenings in the tech world and an attitude to discuss and bring those into play
•	Strong agile/scrum development experience
•	Strong collaboration and communication skills within distributed project teams
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills

[ 能力需求]
技術能力：
• 強大的 Java 8、J2EE SOA、Spring MVC、Spring Boot 和 Unix
• 利用 Spring Boot 和 Drools 規則引擎的微服務
• 消息和緩存技術（Solace/Kafka、Redis、MQ）
• Web UI 技術 Angular-8
• 數據庫編程（Oracle、DB2）

Technical Skills:
•	Strong Java 8, J2EE SOA, Spring MVC, Spring Boot and Unix
•	Microservices leveraging Spring Boot and Drools rules engine
•	Messaging and caching technologies (Solace/Kafka, Redis, MQ)
•	Web UI technologies Angular-8
•	Database Programming (Oracle, DB2)
